name: Apex + contractor
notes: Nina brought Amy Zhou, a contractor from Quill Partners, to help Apex pressure-test the Enterprise evaluation. Amy is staffed on Apex; Quill is not evaluating Helios for itself.

action_items.text: Share the Thursday demo recording and sandbox login with Amy for the Apex Enterprise eval
Send Priya the list of Enterprise eval questions Amy is collecting from Apex stakeholders

transcript.speaker: Nina Volk
transcript.text: Priya, Sam — I brought Amy Zhou. She's a contractor helping Apex on Enterprise. Amy's with Quill Partners, but she's staffed on us. I didn't want you to think Quill was shopping.

transcript.speaker: Amy Zhou
transcript.text: Hi. That's right. I'm Amy Zhou, Quill Partners on the invoice, Apex Robotics on the work. Nina asked me to help run the Enterprise evaluation — requirements, vendor questions, the write-up for her leadership. Quill is not buying Helios. We don't have a sales team to forecast.

transcript.speaker: Priya Shah
transcript.text: Glad you're here. We'll treat this as Apex Enterprise, same thread as Thursday's demo. Amy, what do you need from us to be useful to Nina?

transcript.speaker: Amy Zhou
transcript.text: A sandbox login, the recording, and honest answers on SSO and manager override. I'll collect questions from Apex stakeholders so Nina isn't the only one in the eval. I will not be sending you a Quill master service agreement or asking for Quill pricing.

transcript.speaker: Sam Ortiz
transcript.text: We can add you to the Apex sandbox, not a separate one. If we spin up a Quill workspace it will just confuse everyone.

transcript.speaker: Nina Volk
transcript.text: Please don't. Amy is in our tenant as a guest. This is still Enterprise — Chris, Maya, the Clari comparison, Thursday's demo. Amy is here so I can get a cleaner recommendation for leadership.

transcript.speaker: Amy Zhou
transcript.text: One process note. I'll send you a question list from an amy at quill.partners address because that's my laptop. The questions are Apex's. I'm a contractor on Apex Enterprise, not shopping for Quill.

transcript.speaker: Priya Shah
transcript.text: We'll keep you associated to the Apex work. Anything from the eval I should know that didn't come through on Tuesday?

transcript.speaker: Nina Volk
transcript.text: Amy found that our managers care more about coaching notes than the waterfall. That's helpful against Clari. Thursday should still lead with the override. Amy will join that call if I can get her a hold.

transcript.speaker: Sam Ortiz
transcript.text: I'll add her to the Thursday hold and send sandbox access after this. Nina, you're still who we work with at Apex. Amy is helping you run the eval.

transcript.speaker: Amy Zhou
transcript.text: That's exactly the split. I'll get you the question list today. Thanks for not making this a Quill pitch meeting.

transcript.speaker: Priya Shah
transcript.text: We'll keep this on the Enterprise thread. I'll send sandbox access to both of you so Amy isn't blocked waiting on Nina. Thanks Nina, thanks Amy.

transcript.speaker: Nina Volk
transcript.text: Talk Thursday. Amy, I'll forward you the original Enterprise brief so you're not reconstructing it from this call.

transcript.speaker: Amy Zhou
transcript.text: Already have it — that's why I'm here. See you Thursday.
